subject: music
title: Stave & Treble Clef
welcome_lead: Reading notes on the lines and spaces.
meta_desc: KS3 notation: stave, treble clef, note names.
final_note: Five lines and four spaces hold all the notes.

concepts.def: Five lines used to write music.
Symbol that fixes the lines as G clef.
Clef for lower notes — F clef.
E G B D F on treble lines.
F A C E in treble spaces.
Extra short lines above or below stave.

walkthroughs.body_html: A stave has 5 lines and 4 spaces. The treble clef at the start tells you the lines are E G B D F from bottom to top — 'Every Good Boy Deserves Fruit'.
The four spaces of the treble stave spell FACE from bottom to top — easy to remember.
For notes too high or low for the stave, we add small ledger lines. Middle C sits on one ledger line below the treble stave.
